title: Brainfile Decision Schema
description: Schema for decision documents: a standing choice, not work. A decision has no column and is never completed; it is current until superseded, rejected or stale. The body is the decision and why. 'adr' is an alias: existing type: adr documents read as decisions and keep their IDs. Extends the task schema.

claimKey.description: Dotted claim family the decision belongs to. A family has one current decision; a new one supersedes it.

status.description: Where the decision stands. No status means current. Legacy ADR spellings are accepted: accepted and promoted read as current, deprecated as stale, proposed as not yet decided.

stance.description: What the decision says about its subject.

subject.description: What the stance is about: a package, a pattern, a tool.

holdsWhile.description: The condition under which the decision holds.

recheck.description: When or why to look at it again.

validUntil.description: Date after which the decision is stale.

supersedes.description: The decision or decisions this one replaces.

supersededBy.description: The decision that replaced this one. Setting it makes the decision superseded.

parentId.description: Decisions are never in the tree.

decisions.description: Decisions link to each other with supersedes and supersededBy, not decisions.
